expect_red: a pick resolves to the part's own (sha256, face id) whichever occurrence it lands on, so the event it writes is the one it always wrote

mutations.contract: A binding is part-local: the geometry key a pick contributes is the part's sha256, the face id and that face's manifest record, whichever drawn occurrence the pick landed on.
mutations.note: The mutation lets the occurrence index leak into the face id, which is the shape of the defect this guard exists for: a pick on the tangential link's third occurrence would bind a different face from the same click on its first.
